# **_Better Recipes_**
## Adds Some Much Needed Crafting Recipes

(While Still Keeping It Balanced)

### _📝Some Features Of The Data Pack:_

- Over **60+** New Recipes
- **Improved** Existing Recipes
- Balanced Crafting
- Completely **Vanilla Friendly**

### _🛠️Some New Recipes:_

- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Chainmail
- Nametag
- Saddle
- Horse Armour
- Saplings
- Ores
- Totem
- Elytra
- **AND MORE!**

### _🤔Reviews:_
Wow this is so cool. - **Me**

I love this mod! - **Also Me**

This is essential to any survival world! - **Still Me**
